comment: EXAMPLE STARTING POINT ONLY - NOT A VALIDATED PRODUCTION PROFILE. This profile is a starting point for the opt-in seccomp path (P6.4.1, decision 0033, SECURITY.md multi-tenant hardening). It must be validated against the real workload before any multi-tenant use. defaultAction is SCMP_ACT_ALLOW and it only denies a curated set of administrative syscalls an untrusted candidate has no reason to call (most already require capabilities dropped by --cap-drop ALL, so this is belt-and-suspenders defense-in-depth, not a tight allowlist). A production profile should instead default-deny (SCMP_ACT_ERRNO) with a validated allowlist. No architectures are pinned, so it applies on every arch. SCMP_ACT_ERRNO returns EPERM rather than killing the process.

syscalls.comment: Administrative / namespace / kernel syscalls an untrusted candidate has no reason to call. None are used by a normal python+pytest run (verified by the smoke test, which is a smoke test, NOT a security validation). Tighten to a default-deny allowlist for production.
